title: Orunmila log continuation record, schema version 1
description: The first line of a log's second (or later) part. A crash can cut a log's last line short; that log is never edited. The restart starts a new part beside it, and this record, the new part's first line, says where the previous part was cut. One hash chain runs through all the parts (spec/hash-chain.md, "A log in parts").
$comment: agent's choice, LD57 (format change approved by O 2026-11-17: "the restart would start a second part of the log beside it, recording where the first part broke"). Unknown fields are allowed, as in the other v1 drafts (LD17).

session_id.description: The session whose log this part continues.

log.description: Which of the session's logs this part continues: `raw` (the marks) or `quarantine` (inputs that were not valid marks).

part.description: This part's number: 2 for the file `raw.2.jsonl` or `quarantine.2.jsonl`, and so on. Part 1 is the log's own file.

seq.description: One more than the `seq` of the last whole line before the cut. The lines after it count on from here.

cut.description: Where the previous part was cut, and what was left there.

line.description: The cut line's number in the previous part, counting from 1.

bytes.description: How many bytes of the cut line were written before the crash.

fingerprint.description: The plain SHA-256 of those bytes, so the cut line left in the previous part can be checked and never changed.

prev_hash.description: The `hash` of the last whole line before the cut, exactly as written there.
prev_hash.$comment: agent's choice, LD57; the chain rule is brief v3 line 247

hash.description: This record's hash, by the same rule as every line (spec/hash-chain.md).
